import asyncio
async def run_jobs(jobs, token):
    results=[]
    for job in jobs:
        if token.is_cancelled(): break
        results.append(await job())
    return results

    result=dict(defaults)
    result.update(project)
    result.update({key[4:].lower():value for key,value in env.items() if key.startswith("APP_")})
    return result
